identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Kill the generic SaaS look. Create 'Clinical Vibrance'.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Print with Electric Neon.
Emotion First: Data should feel like a superpower, not a chore.
Content is King: The data itself is the art. Everything else frames it.
Zoom In: Focus on the micro-interactions of data cleaning.
Negative Space: Use whitespace as a luxury.
Contrast: High contrast for data legibility is non-negotiable.

visual_strategy.description: A clean, lab-like environment (White/Slate) where data is treated with surgical precision, injected with electric bursts of color (Indigo/Neon) to signify AI intelligence.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles and section headers. Bold and tight.

body.usage: General UI text, labels, and descriptions.

data.usage: Table data, code snippets, transformation rules, formulas.

primary.description: Electric Indigo. Use for Primary Actions (Save, Run, Connect).

secondary.description: Slate 200. Use for secondary buttons and filters.

accent.description: Teal for clean data, Rose for errors, Violet for AI suggestions.

spacing.scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.
spacing.containers: p-8 md:p-12 for main content areas.

layout.dashboard: Bento Grid (Mode B). Dense but breathable.
layout.landing: Asymmetric Tetris Grid (Mode A). Overlapping elements.

customization_rules: Radius: Rounded-lg (0.5rem) for a modern, friendly feel.
Shadows: Soft, ambient shadows (shadow-sm) for cards. No heavy drops.
Borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. No borderless cards.
Inputs: Tall inputs (h-10 or h-12) with bg-white.

specific_components.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl p-6

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-500/20 font-medium rounded-lg h-10 px-6
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-medium rounded-lg h-10 px-6

specific_components.tables: border-collapse. Header: bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500. Rows: hover:bg-slate-50/50. Cell padding: py-3 px-4.
specific_components.badge: Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold. Use distinct colors for status.

images.description: Blue and green abstract waves. Use as a subtle background layer or hero image.
Vibrant ribbons. Use for the 'AI Transformation' feature section.
Clean desk setup. Use for 'User Productivity' section.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React (already installed). Use 'Activity', 'Database', 'Wand2' (for AI), 'FileSpreadsheet' (for Excel), 'Zap' (for speed).

universal_guidelines: Avoid the 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts or gradients everywhere.
No Transition All: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200).
Data-TestID: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Feedback Loops: Every action (click, save, delete) must have a toast notification (Sonner) or visual state change.
Empty States: Never leave a list empty. Show a helpful illustration and a 'Create New' button.
Loading States: Use Skeletons (Shadcn) that match the layout, not generic spinners.
implementation_steps: Step 1: Configure Tailwind with the 'Clinical Vibrance' palette.
Step 2: Install Shadcn components (Button, Card, Input, Table, Dialog, Sheet, Sonner).
Step 3: Create the 'AppShell' layout (Sidebar + Header + Main Content Area).
Step 4: Build the Data Ingestion Flow (File Upload -> Preview -> Transform).
Step 5: Implement the Dashboard with Bento Grids and Recharts.
